categories.title: Entry and lifecycle
categories.summary: Create the application runtime, install the adapter, and release its observers.

entries.name: createPling
entries.summary: Creates the application-level Pling instance and returns the adapter-specific runtime object.
entries.signature:
createPling(options?: PlingOptions): PlingElement;
createPling(registry: Registry | undefined, options?: PlingOptions): PlingElement;

parameters.name: ui.locale
parameters.description: Language used by the built-in assistant UI. "auto" follows the browser language.
parameters.descriptionZh: 内置助手界面的语言。传 `auto` 时跟随浏览器语言。

parameters.name: ui.theme
parameters.description: Theme for the built-in surfaces. An object can override tokens or choose a mode.
parameters.descriptionZh: 内置界面的主题。传对象时可选择模式或覆盖设计令牌。

parameters.name: ui.theme.mode
parameters.description: Explicit mode when the theme is an object. "auto" follows the operating-system preference.
parameters.descriptionZh: 主题传对象时指定的模式。`auto` 跟随操作系统外观。

parameters.name: ui.theme.tokens
parameters.description: Overrides individual design tokens such as colours, radii, shadows, and font families. Keys not supplied keep the selected light or dark defaults.
parameters.descriptionZh: 覆盖颜色、圆角、阴影、字体等单个设计令牌。未提供的键沿用所选明色或暗色主题的默认值。

parameters.name: ui.messages
parameters.description: Adds or replaces message catalog entries for one or more locales.
parameters.descriptionZh: 为一个或多个语言补充或替换界面文案。

parameters.name: ui.messages.<locale>
parameters.description: Message overrides for one BCP 47 locale. Missing keys fall back to the built-in catalog.
parameters.descriptionZh: 某个 BCP 47 语言的文案覆盖。未提供的键回退到内置文案。

parameters.name: ui.classNames
parameters.description: Extra class names applied to the built-in chat, dock, launcher, and panel.
parameters.descriptionZh: 为内置对话、浮窗、启动按钮和面板附加 class。

parameters.name: ui.classNames.dock
parameters.description: Extra class for the dock shell.
parameters.descriptionZh: 浮窗外壳的附加 class。

parameters.name: ui.classNames.panel
parameters.description: Extra class for the panel shell.
parameters.descriptionZh: 面板外壳的附加 class。

parameters.name: ui.classNames.launcher
parameters.description: Extra class for the launcher button.
parameters.descriptionZh: 启动按钮的附加 class。

parameters.name: ui.classNames.chat
parameters.description: Extra class for the chat surface.
parameters.descriptionZh: 对话界面的附加 class。

parameters.name: onWarn
parameters.description: Receives development warnings and declaration diagnostics. Defaults to console.warn.
parameters.descriptionZh: 接收开发期告警和声明诊断。默认输出到 `console.warn`。

parameters.name: registry
parameters.description: Uses an existing action registry instead of creating one. Do not combine it with shared.
parameters.descriptionZh: 使用已有动作注册表，而不是新建一个。不要与 `shared` 同时传入。

parameters.name: shared
parameters.description: Joins a page runtime shared by several framework islands. registry and scopes are then owned by that page runtime.
parameters.descriptionZh: 接入多个框架孤岛共用的页面运行时。此时 `registry` 与 `scopes` 由页面统一持有。

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Prefixes action and record ids for this adapter instance, for example add becomes todo/add.
parameters.descriptionZh: 为该适配器实例的动作与记录 id 加前缀，例如 `add` 变成 `todo/add`。

parameters.name: scopes
parameters.description: Overrides visibility and hit-testing behavior. Intended for tests and unusual rendering hosts.
parameters.descriptionZh: 覆盖可见性与命中测试行为。主要用于测试和特殊渲染宿主。

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: Wires the model, hooks, confirmation, continuity, and observability used by built-in assistant surfaces.
parameters.descriptionZh: 接线内置助手界面使用的模型、钩子、确认、连续性与观测能力。

parameters.name: derive
parameters.description: Enables optional L1 derivation from native clickable elements. Disabled by default; derived actions are marked as guesses.
parameters.descriptionZh: 开启可选的 L1 派生：从原生可点击元素推断动作。默认关闭；派生动作会标记为推断结果。

parameters.name: presence
parameters.description: Controls target highlighting while the agent operates the page.
parameters.descriptionZh: 控制 agent 操作页面时的目标高亮。

parameters.name: revealSensitive
parameters.description: Restores sensitive-value tokens to their real values in the rendered chat only. Model requests and storage keep the tokens.
parameters.descriptionZh: 仅在渲染层把敏感值代号还原为真值。发给模型的请求和存储中仍保留代号。

parameters.name: diagnostics
parameters.description: Scans the mounted root once for actionable controls without declarations and reports coverage through onWarn. Enabled by default only in Vite dev mode.
parameters.descriptionZh: 挂载后扫描一次未声明的可操作控件，并通过 `onWarn` 报告覆盖率。仅在 Vite 开发模式下默认开启。

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Controls page identity collection. Defaults to location plus document.title; pass false to disable it.
parameters.descriptionZh: 控制页面身份收集。默认读取 `location` 与 `document.title`；传 `false` 关闭。

entries.returns: The adapter instance. Vue 3 and React return PlingElement; Vue 2.7 and Vanilla return VanillaPling.
defaults: No declaration means no action; derive is off by default.

examples.title: Vue 3 application setup
Route model calls through a same-origin gateway
examples.titleZh: 通过同源网关调用模型

entries.name: usePling
entries.summary: Reads the nearest Pling instance from the framework tree.

examples.title: Read the injected runtime
examples.code:
const pling = usePling();

onMounted(() => pling.inspectCoverage());

entries.name: pling.plugin
entries.summary: Installs Vue directives and the runtime injection key. React uses PlingProvider instead.

examples.title: Install Vue 3 directives
examples.code: createApp(App).use(pling.plugin).mount("#app");

entries.name: PlingElement
entries.summary: The Vue 3 and React application runtime: registry, UI controller, page tracker, task routing, coverage, and cleanup.

parameters.name: registry
parameters.description: Shared action, record, state, and feedback registry.
parameters.descriptionZh: 共享的动作、记录、状态与反馈注册表。

parameters.name: ui
parameters.description: Locale, theme, catalog, and CSS-variable controller.
parameters.descriptionZh: 语言、主题、文案目录与 CSS 变量控制器。

parameters.name: feedback
parameters.description: Page-level feedback collector shared by the application.
parameters.descriptionZh: 应用共用的页面级反馈收集器。

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Tracks route, path, title, and selected query parameters.
parameters.descriptionZh: 跟踪路由、路径、标题与白名单查询参数。

parameters.name: plugin
parameters.description: Vue plugin that registers directives and the injection key.
parameters.descriptionZh: 注册指令与注入键的 Vue 插件。

parameters.name: ask
parameters.description: Routes a human-authored task to a mounted assistant surface.
parameters.descriptionZh: 把用户发起的任务交给已挂载的助手界面。

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Task routing controller used by built-in surfaces.
parameters.descriptionZh: 内置界面使用的任务路由控制器。

parameters.name: derived
parameters.description: Returns the optional L1 deriver. It is null unless derive was enabled.
parameters.descriptionZh: 返回可选的 L1 派生器。未开启 `derive` 时为 `null`。

parameters.name: inspectCoverage
parameters.description: Scans the mounted root for actionable controls without declarations.
parameters.descriptionZh: 扫描挂载根，报告未声明的可操作控件。

parameters.name: scopes
parameters.description: Region visibility, viewport, and occlusion controller.
parameters.descriptionZh: 区域可见性、视口与遮挡控制器。

parameters.name: setActiveScopes
parameters.description: Manually replaces the active region set when automatic detection is not suitable.
parameters.descriptionZh: 自动判定不适用时，手动替换活跃区域集合。

parameters.name: destroy
parameters.description: Stops observers and releases declarations owned by this runtime.
parameters.descriptionZh: 停止观察器并释放该运行时持有的声明。

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: Application-level assistant wiring, when supplied to createPling.
parameters.descriptionZh: 传给 `createPling` 的应用级助手接线。

parameters.name: revealSensitive
parameters.description: Whether the rendered chat restores sensitive tokens.
parameters.descriptionZh: 渲染对话时是否还原敏感值代号。

examples.title: Inspect what the page exposes
examples.code:
const pling = createPling();

console.table(pling.inspectCoverage().targets);

entries.name: pling.destroy
entries.summary: Stops observers, derived actions, scopes, presence, UI subscriptions, and mounted assistant surfaces.

examples.title: Release the runtime
examples.code: onBeforeUnmount(() => pling.destroy());

categories.title: Page declarations
categories.summary: Declare actions, records, regions, state, feedback, task entrances, and sensitive values.

entries.name: Element action
entries.summary: Declares what a control does. The description is the model's only explanation; execution still goes through availability, approval, and expectations.

parameters.name: v-tool
parameters.description: A string is a description shorthand. Use an object or array when you need a stable id, risk level, parameters, flow steps, expectations, or a custom run function.
parameters.descriptionZh: 字符串是一句说明的简写。需要稳定 id、风险等级、参数、流程、成功判据或自定义执行时，传对象或数组。

examples.title: String shorthand
examples.code: <button v-tool="'添加一条待办'">添加</button>

examples.title: Stable id and injected run
examples.titleZh: 稳定 id 与注入执行
examples.code:
<button v-tool="{
  id: 'add',
  desc: '添加一条待办',
  kind: 'write',
  available: () => draft.trim() ? true : '先输入待办内容',
  run: () => add(),
}">添加</button>

entries.name: Function-level action
entries.summary: Registers a business operation that has no dedicated DOM control.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Id, description, risk, availability, parameters, expectation, and implementation.
parameters.descriptionZh: id、说明、风险、可用性、参数、成功判据与实现。

examples.title: Register an application action

entries.name: Region
entries.summary: Declares a structural region and its reachability. Regions explain context; they are not permission boundaries.
entries.signature: v-scope="string | { id; label?; description?; role?; parent? }"

parameters.name: v-scope
parameters.description: A string is a stable region id. The object form adds a label, description, structural role, or explicit parent.
parameters.descriptionZh: 字符串是稳定区域 id。对象形式可补区域名、说明、结构角色或显式父区域。

examples.title: Describe a list region
examples.code: <section v-scope="{ id: 'todos', label: '待办列表', role: 'list' }">...</section>

entries.name: Record
entries.summary: Gives one row a stable identity and a bounded set of readable fields. Records are read-only.

parameters.name: v-record
parameters.description: The row object, or a { data, id, label, fields } envelope that limits what the model can read.
parameters.descriptionZh: 行对象，或 `{ data, id, label, fields }` 包装对象，用来限制模型可读字段。

entries.name: Read-only state
entries.summary: Exposes a derived view of current UI state. State has no setter; writes must be declared as actions.
entries.signature: useAgentState(key: string, source: StateSource, options?: AgentStateOptions | string): () => void

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Stable state-view name used in page context and diagnostics.
parameters.descriptionZh: 用于页面上下文与诊断的稳定状态名。

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: A value, ref, or read function. Prefer a function so the snapshot reflects current state.
parameters.descriptionZh: 值、ref 或读取函数。推荐传函数，让每次快照都反映当前状态。

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A description object or a description string. Name the view and explain what it means.
parameters.descriptionZh: 说明对象或说明字符串。写清这组状态是什么。

examples.title: Expose filters and counts

entries.name: Store state
entries.summary: Selects named fields from a Pinia or Vuex store. It never exposes the whole store.
entries.signature: useAgentStoreState<S extends object>(key: string, store: S, read: AgentStoreRead<S>, options?: AgentStateOptions | string): () => void

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Stable state-view name.
parameters.descriptionZh: 稳定状态名。

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Pinia or Vuex store-like object.
parameters.descriptionZh: Pinia 或 Vuex 风格的 store 对象。

parameters.name: read
parameters.description: An allowlist of fields or a selector that returns a bounded view.
parameters.descriptionZh: 字段白名单，或返回有界视图的 selector。

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Description shown with the state in model context.
parameters.descriptionZh: 随状态一起进入模型上下文的说明。

examples.title: Expose a store allowlist
examples.titleZh: 暴露 store 字段白名单
examples.code:
const cart = useCartStore();
useAgentStoreState("cart", cart, ["count", "total"], "购物车件数与小计");

entries.name: Page feedback
entries.summary: Publishes user-visible feedback or a short page-level explanation without turning it into an action.

parameters.name: v-feedback
parameters.description: A string, or an object with message, field, severity, scope, and id. Use functions for fields that change.
parameters.descriptionZh: 字符串，或包含 `message`、`field`、`severity`、`scope`、`id` 的对象。变化的值可用函数读取。

examples.title: Expose a form error

entries.name: Task entrance
entries.summary: Routes a human-authored instruction to the mounted assistant. It is not exposed to the model as an action.
entries.signature:
v-task="string | TaskOptions"
pling.ask(prompt: string, options?: PlingAskOptions): Promise<void>

parameters.name: v-task
parameters.description: A prompt string, or an object with prompt, surface, and disabled.
parameters.descriptionZh: 提示词字符串，或包含 `prompt`、`surface`、`disabled` 的对象。

examples.title: Route a human task
examples.code: <button v-task="'整理今天的待办并标出最紧急的一项'">让助手整理</button>

entries.name: Guide target
entries.summary: Highlights a non-action target while a person completes a handoff step.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Guide target id referenced by a HandoffStep.highlight value.
parameters.descriptionZh: 被 `HandoffStep.highlight` 引用的引导目标 id。

examples.title: Highlight a handoff target
examples.code: <input v-guide-target="'captcha'" />

entries.name: sensitive
entries.summary: Marks a value for outbound masking, tokenization, or a hint while keeping the field name visible.
entries.signature: sensitive<T>(value: T, options?: SensitivityMode | SensitiveOptions): SensitiveValue<T>

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value that enters page context and the model transcript.
parameters.descriptionZh: 会进入页面上下文与模型对话的值。

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Controls whether the model sees a placeholder or no value. The real value remains in the browser.
parameters.descriptionZh: 控制模型看到占位代号还是不看到值。真值仍留在浏览器内。

examples.title: Mask a phone number
examples.code: const phone = sensitive(customer.phone, "masked");

categories.title: Shared option types
categories.summary: The option shapes referenced by declarations. Adapter aliases are listed where the name differs.

entries.name: ToolOptions
entries.summary: The action declaration shape shared by every adapter.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: Required model-facing description of what the control or operation does. This is the primary signal used to select the tool.
parameters.descriptionZh: 必填的面向模型说明，描述控件或操作做什么。这是模型选择工具时最主要的依据。

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Stable action id. Omit only for one-off controls; list rows and flows should use stable ids.
parameters.descriptionZh: 稳定动作 id。仅一次性控件可以省略；列表行与流程应显式提供。

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Risk level used for approval and auditing. Omitted values are fail-closed and treated as write.
parameters.descriptionZh: 用于确认与审计的风险等级。省略时按 fail-closed 视为 `write`。

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Overrides approval derivation. false skips confirmation, true requires it, and always never offers a persistent allow option.
parameters.descriptionZh: 覆盖确认推导。`false` 跳过确认，`true` 要求确认，`always` 每次询问且不提供长期允许。

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Overrides primitive inference. By default form inputs use fill and other elements use click.
parameters.descriptionZh: 覆盖动作原语推断。默认表单输入使用填写，其余元素使用点击。

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Key used by an action whose primitive is press.
parameters.descriptionZh: 原语为按键时使用的键名。

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Explicit region id. Omitted values inherit the nearest declared scope.
parameters.descriptionZh: 显式区域 id。省略时继承最近声明的区域。

parameters.name: fidelity
parameters.description: Declares how trustworthy the execution target is. Setting it stops automatic target relocation.
parameters.descriptionZh: 声明执行目标的可靠程度。显式设置后不再自动定位目标。

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: CSS selector, scoped to the declared element, used to choose the concrete target.
parameters.descriptionZh: 限定在声明元素内部查找具体目标的 CSS 选择器。

parameters.name: autoTarget
parameters.description: Automatically locates a unique native control inside the declared element.
parameters.descriptionZh: 自动定位声明元素内部唯一的原生控件。

parameters.name: available
parameters.description: Business precondition checked before the action appears as available. A returned string is shown to the model as the reason.
parameters.descriptionZh: 动作出现前检查的业务前置条件。返回字符串时，该字符串会作为不可用原因交给模型。

parameters.name: expect
parameters.description: Success criterion checked after execution. Failure produces EXPECTATION_FAILED instead of a false success.
parameters.descriptionZh: 执行后检查的成功判据。不成立时返回 `EXPECTATION_FAILED`，不会把未完成当成功。

parameters.name: handoff
parameters.description: Hands the step to the user instead of simulating it. The boolean or string form supplies the reason.
parameters.descriptionZh: 把这一步交给用户完成，而不是模拟操作。布尔值或字符串形式提供原因。

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Parameter schema for the parameterized form. When present, run receives the validated parameter object rather than a single primitive value.
parameters.descriptionZh: 带参数表单使用的参数声明。存在时，`run` 收到校验后的参数对象，而不是单个原语值。

parameters.name: run
parameters.description: Injected implementation. Atomic actions receive the primitive value; parameterized actions receive the full argument object. Ignored when steps is present.
parameters.descriptionZh: 注入的执行实现。原子动作收到原语值；带参数动作收到完整参数对象。写了 `steps` 时不会运行。

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Turns the declaration into a single model-facing flow that executes registered action ids in order. Do not combine it with run.
parameters.descriptionZh: 把声明变成对模型可见的单个流程，按顺序执行已注册动作 id。不要与 `run` 同时使用。

examples.title: Parameterized declaration

entries.name: ScopeOptions
entries.summary: The region declaration shape. Vue 3 exposes the equivalent value as ScopeValue.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Stable region id. It is written to the DOM and inherited by descendant declarations.
parameters.descriptionZh: 稳定区域 id。会写入 DOM，并由后代声明继承。

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Short model-facing name, for example 待办列表.
parameters.descriptionZh: 面向模型的短名称，例如“待办列表”。

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Explains what the region is for and when actions inside it apply.
parameters.descriptionZh: 说明区域的用途，以及其中动作适用的场景。

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Structural role such as main, dialog, toolbar, or list. It affects reading order and context, not permissions.
parameters.descriptionZh: `main`、`dialog`、`toolbar`、`list` 等结构角色。只影响阅读顺序与上下文，不构成权限边界。

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Explicit parent region id for portals, overlays, or detach-to-body cases.
parameters.descriptionZh: 为传送门、浮层或挂到 body 的节点显式指定父区域 id。

examples.title: Region metadata

entries.name: RecordValue
entries.summary: A row value or a full record declaration with explicit id, label, and fields.

parameters.name: plain object.id | key
parameters.description: Default primary key when the row itself is passed as a plain object.
parameters.descriptionZh: 直接把行对象作为记录时，默认从 `id` 或 `key` 读取主键。

parameters.name: envelope.data
parameters.description: Row data wrapped in the explicit record envelope.
parameters.descriptionZh: 使用显式记录包装时承载的行数据。

parameters.name: envelope.id
parameters.description: Overrides the primary key when the field is not named id or key.
parameters.descriptionZh: 主键字段不叫 `id` / `key` 时用它覆盖。

parameters.name: envelope.label
parameters.description: Human- and model-readable row label.
parameters.descriptionZh: 给人也给模型看的行说明。

parameters.name: envelope.fields
parameters.description: Allowlist of fields visible to the model. Without it, all row fields except the primary key are exposed.
parameters.descriptionZh: 模型可见字段白名单。不写时暴露除主键外的全部行字段。

examples.title: Explicit field allowlist

entries.name: State options
entries.summary: Optional description for a read-only state view.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Explains the state view and its units or bounds. Describe a view, not the entire store.
parameters.descriptionZh: 说明状态视图及其单位或范围。描述的是一个有界视图，不是整个 store。

examples.title: Describe a bounded view
examples.code: { description: "当前筛选项、总条数与未完成条数" }

entries.name: AgentSetup
entries.summary: Application-level runtime options: model overrides, hooks, gates, event handling, trace, and continuity.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Partial model and runtime configuration. Omitted fields are read from VITE_AGENT_* environment variables or framework defaults.
parameters.descriptionZh: 模型与运行时的局部配置。未写的字段从 `VITE_AGENT_*` 环境变量或框架默认值读取。

parameters.name: llm
parameters.description: Injects the model call function. Use it for a test model, a server proxy, or a non-OpenAI-compatible transport.
parameters.descriptionZh: 注入模型调用函数。可用于测试模型、服务端代理或非 OpenAI 兼容传输。

parameters.name: responseLocale
parameters.description: Locale used when composing the response-language instruction. A function is re-read before each model request.
parameters.descriptionZh: 拼接回答语言约束时使用的语言。传函数时，每次模型请求前重新读取。

parameters.name: telemetry
parameters.description: Collects token, duration, cost, and retry metrics for the current runtime.
parameters.descriptionZh: 收集当前运行时的 token、耗时、成本与重试指标。

parameters.name: trace
parameters.description: Keeps a bounded in-memory trace of model requests for the read-only inspector. Disabled by default.
parameters.descriptionZh: 在内存中保留有界的模型请求记录，供只读诊断面板查看。默认关闭。

parameters.name: settle
parameters.description: Replaces the page-settle wait used between actions. Most useful in deterministic tests and non-browser hosts.
parameters.descriptionZh: 替换动作之间的页面落定等待。主要用于确定性测试和非浏览器宿主。

parameters.name: hooks
parameters.description: Tool lifecycle hooks shared by every surface created from this application runtime.
parameters.descriptionZh: 由该应用运行时创建的界面共用的工具生命周期钩子。

parameters.name: onEvent
parameters.description: Receives the same session event stream that powers the chat and activity views.
parameters.descriptionZh: 接收与对话、运行视图相同的会话事件流。

parameters.name: onApproval
parameters.description: Called when an approval request appears or clears. Use it to connect a custom approval UI.
parameters.descriptionZh: 确认请求出现或清除时调用。可用来接自己的确认界面。

parameters.name: onHandoff
parameters.description: Called when a human-handoff request appears or clears.
parameters.descriptionZh: 人工接力请求出现或清除时调用。

parameters.name: policy

parameters.name: [].name

parameters.name: [].type

parameters.descriptionZh: 把参数标为可选。参数默认必填。

parameters.name: [].values

parameters.descriptionZh: 静态封闭值集合。模型只能从已知值里选择时使用。

parameters.name: [].options
parameters.description: Dynamic value set, re-read for each snapshot and execution.
parameters.descriptionZh: 动态值集合，每次快照与执行前重新读取。

parameters.name: [].min | [].max
parameters.description: Numeric bounds for number arguments, including dynamic bounds.
parameters.descriptionZh: 数字参数的上下界，也支持动态边界。

parameters.name: [].minLength | [].maxLength
parameters.description: String length bounds.
parameters.descriptionZh: 字符串长度边界。

parameters.name: [].pattern
parameters.description: Regular-expression constraint for a string argument.
parameters.descriptionZh: 字符串参数的正则约束。

parameters.name: [].format
parameters.description: Semantic format validation. A date must be a real calendar date.
parameters.descriptionZh: 语义格式校验。`date` 还要求是真实存在的日期。

parameters.name: JSON Schema.properties
parameters.description: Property schemas for the direct JSON Schema form.
parameters.descriptionZh: 直接 JSON Schema 形式的属性定义。

parameters.name: classNames.dock

parameters.name: classNames.panel

parameters.name: classNames.launcher
parameters.description: Extra class for the launcher button.
parameters.descriptionZh: 启动按钮的附加 class。

parameters.name: classNames.chat
parameters.description: Extra class for the chat surface.
parameters.descriptionZh: 对话界面的附加 class。

parameters.name: defaultLocale

categories.title: External Agent Surface
categories.summary: Vue wrappers for exposing declared capabilities through a Surface gateway. They manage credentials and transport; the capability allowlist and human approval stay in the application.

entries.name: useSurfaceGateway
entries.summary: Creates and owns the page session, WebSocket, Surface bridge, pairing, claim, and revocation lifecycle for one Vue component scope.

parameters.name: app
parameters.description: Stable application name sent in the bridge hello.
parameters.descriptionZh: 桥接 hello 中发送的稳定应用名。

parameters.name: expose
parameters.description: Explicit capability allowlist. The composable never infers capabilities from the DOM or registry.
parameters.descriptionZh: 显式能力 allowlist。组合式函数不会从 DOM 或注册表自动推断能力。

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: public-demo creates a page session from the browser and may show an Agent token. bff requires getPageSession and must be backed by an authenticated application server.
parameters.descriptionZh: `public-demo` 在浏览器创建页面会话并可展示 Agent token；`bff` 必须提供 `getPageSession`，由已认证的应用后端创建页面会话。

parameters.name: gatewayUrl
parameters.description: Gateway origin for public-demo mode, for example https://surface.example.com.
parameters.descriptionZh: `public-demo` 模式的网关源，例如 `https://surface.example.com`。

parameters.name: getPageSession
parameters.description: Required in bff mode. The application server verifies the user session and returns only a short-lived page session.
parameters.descriptionZh: `bff` 模式必填。应用服务端验证用户会话后，只返回短时页面会话。

parameters.name: gatewayClient
parameters.description: Injected HTTP client for tests or a custom BFF contract.
parameters.descriptionZh: 用于测试或自定义 BFF 契约的 HTTP 客户端。

parameters.name: approval
parameters.description: Human approval source. Its subscribe callback relays pending state; the page still owns the decision UI.
parameters.descriptionZh: 真人审批来源。它订阅并转发待审批状态；决定界面仍归页面所有。

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Confirmation function used by the Surface executor. Defaults to approval.confirm, then null (fail closed).
parameters.descriptionZh: Surface 执行器使用的确认函数。默认取 `approval.confirm`，否则为 `null`（fail-closed）。

parameters.name: autoConnect
parameters.description: Connects when the component mounts. Set false when the host owns an explicit connect button.
parameters.descriptionZh: 组件挂载时自动连接。传 `false` 时由宿主提供显式连接按钮。

parameters.name: autoClaim
parameters.description: Claims an Agent token automatically. Defaults to true only in public-demo mode.
parameters.descriptionZh: 是否自动申领 Agent token。仅在 `public-demo` 模式下默认开启。

parameters.name: agentId
parameters.description: Agent id recorded when claiming a public-demo pairing.
parameters.descriptionZh: 申领公开演示配对时记录的 Agent id。

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: Optional tenant hint for the public-demo page-session endpoint.
parameters.descriptionZh: 公开演示页面会话端点的可选租户提示。

parameters.name: clientKey
parameters.description: Optional client hint for the public-demo page-session endpoint.
parameters.descriptionZh: 公开演示页面会话端点的可选客户端提示。

parameters.name: reconnectMs
parameters.description: Delay before reconnecting the page WebSocket.
parameters.descriptionZh: 页面 WebSocket 重连延迟。

parameters.name: webSocket
parameters.description: WebSocket implementation injection for tests or non-browser hosts.
parameters.descriptionZh: 供测试或非浏览器宿主注入的 WebSocket 实现。

parameters.name: surface
parameters.description: Extra Surface options such as recordLimit, rateLimit, replay, audit, or custom settle.
parameters.descriptionZh: 额外的 Surface 选项，例如 `recordLimit`、`rateLimit`、`replay`、审计或自定义落定等待。

examples.title: Public demo with an explicit allowlist
examples.titleZh: 公开演示：显式能力清单

entries.name: SurfaceAccessPanel
entries.summary: Optional Vue panel for connection state, pairing, a copyable Agent token, the current scope, and revocation. It renders a controller; it does not create capabilities.

parameters.name: gateway
parameters.description: Controller returned by useSurfaceGateway. The component renders its state but never creates capabilities or tokens by itself.
parameters.descriptionZh: `useSurfaceGateway` 返回的控制器。组件只渲染其状态，不会自行创建能力或 token。

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Panel title. Defaults to the localized External Agent label.
parameters.descriptionZh: 面板标题。默认使用当前语言的“外部 Agent”文案。

examples.title: Render the optional access panel
examples.code: <SurfaceAccessPanel :gateway="gateway" title="外部 Agent" />

categories.title: Page identity and continuity
categories.summary: Read page identity, share a runtime across frames, and inspect declared coverage.

entries.name: PageOptions
entries.summary: Controls automatic page identity, router integration, query allowlisting, hash handling, and title overrides.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Enables page identity collection. createPling({ page: false }) is the shorthand for disabling it.
parameters.descriptionZh: 开启页面身份收集。`createPling({ page: false })` 是关闭它的简写。

parameters.name: router
parameters.description: Vue Router-like object that supplies route name, params, hash, and meta.title. If omitted, the adapter tries $router after mount.
parameters.descriptionZh: 提供路由名称、参数、hash 与 `meta.title` 的 Vue Router 风格对象。省略时，适配器在挂载后尝试读取 `$router`。

parameters.name: queryKeys
parameters.description: Allowlist of query parameters exposed to the model. Query parameters are hidden by default.
parameters.descriptionZh: 允许进入模型上下文的查询参数白名单。查询参数默认全部隐藏。

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: Includes safe hash fragments. Hash values that resemble query strings are ignored.
parameters.descriptionZh: 是否包含安全的 hash 片段。看起来像查询串的 hash 会被忽略。

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Title override or fallback. It takes precedence over route meta.title and document.title.
parameters.descriptionZh: 标题覆盖或兜底值。优先于路由 `meta.title` 与 `document.title`。

examples.title: Expose route identity without tokens
examples.titleZh: 暴露路由身份但不暴露令牌

entries.name: PlingPage
entries.summary: A page-level runtime shared by multiple framework islands or same-origin frames.

parameters.name: registry
parameters.description: Shared action, record, state, and feedback registry.
parameters.descriptionZh: 共享的动作、记录、状态与反馈注册表。

parameters.name: scopes
parameters.description: Shared region visibility and occlusion controller.
parameters.descriptionZh: 共享的区域可见性与遮挡控制器。

parameters.name: feedback
parameters.description: Page-level feedback collector that observes the document once.
parameters.descriptionZh: 每个页面只观察一次文档的反馈收集器。

parameters.name: destroy()
parameters.description: Stops page observers and clears automatic scopes. Adapters should destroy their declarations first.
parameters.descriptionZh: 停止页面观察器并清空自动区域。适配器应先释放自己的声明。

examples.title: Share one page runtime

entries.name: createPlingPage
entries.summary: Creates the shared registry, scopes, and page identity that adapters can join with shared.

parameters.name: options.registry
parameters.description: Existing registry to share. A new registry is created when omitted.
parameters.descriptionZh: 要共享的已有注册表。省略时新建一个。

parameters.name: options.scopes
parameters.description: Visibility and hit-testing overrides for the shared page.
parameters.descriptionZh: 共享页面的可见性与命中测试覆盖项。

examples.title: Create a mixed-framework page runtime
examples.titleZh: 创建混合框架页面运行时

entries.name: sharePlingPageWithFrame
entries.summary: Shares a page runtime with a same-origin iframe and returns a cleanup function.

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: Same-origin iframe that should receive the shared page runtime.
parameters.descriptionZh: 接收共享页面运行时的同源 iframe。

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Runtime created by createPlingPage.
parameters.descriptionZh: 由 `createPlingPage` 创建的运行时。

examples.title: Share a runtime with a same-origin frame
examples.titleZh: 向同源 iframe 共享运行时

entries.name: plingPageFromParent
entries.summary: Reads a shared page runtime from the parent window when the current document is an embedded frame.

parameters.name: win
parameters.description: Window whose parent should be checked. Defaults to the current window.
parameters.descriptionZh: 要检查父窗口的窗口对象。默认当前窗口。

examples.title: Read a shared page synchronously
examples.titleZh: 同步读取共享页面运行时
examples.code:
const page = plingPageFromParent();
if (page) createPling({ shared: page });

entries.name: waitForPlingPageFromParent
entries.summary: Waits for a parent frame to publish its page runtime.

parameters.name: options.window
parameters.description: Child window to listen on. Defaults to the current window.
parameters.descriptionZh: 要监听的子窗口。默认当前窗口。

parameters.name: options.timeoutMs
parameters.description: Maximum wait. Zero waits indefinitely. Rejects when another positive timeout expires.
parameters.descriptionZh: 最长等待时间。传 `0` 表示一直等；其他正数超时后 Promise 会拒绝。

examples.title: Wait for the parent runtime
examples.code:
const page = await waitForPlingPageFromParent({ timeoutMs: 8000 });
createPling({ shared: page });

entries.name: inspectCoverage
entries.summary: Scans the mounted page for interactive controls that have no declaration. It reports; it never registers an action.

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: Application root to scan. Vue uses its mount root; React and DOM callers may pass any root.
parameters.descriptionZh: 要扫描的应用根。Vue 使用挂载根；React 与原生调用方可传任意根元素。

parameters.name: return.total
parameters.description: Recognized actionable controls in the root.
parameters.descriptionZh: 根元素内识别到的可操作控件总数。

parameters.name: return.declared
parameters.description: Controls with a direct declaration.
parameters.descriptionZh: 有直接声明的控件数。

parameters.name: return.derived
parameters.description: Controls produced by optional L1 derivation.
parameters.descriptionZh: 由可选 L1 派生生成的动作数。

parameters.name: return.grouped
parameters.description: Controls covered by a declaration on an ancestor. Review these manually.
parameters.descriptionZh: 由祖先声明覆盖的控件数。需要人工复核映射关系。

parameters.name: return.missing
parameters.description: Actionable controls with no declaration in their ancestry.
parameters.descriptionZh: 祖先链上没有任何声明的可操作控件数。

parameters.name: return.coveragePercent
parameters.description: Covered controls divided by total; null when there are no controls.
parameters.descriptionZh: 覆盖控件数除以总数；没有控件时为 `null`。

parameters.name: return.targets
parameters.description: Grouped and missing controls with labels and nearby action ids.
parameters.descriptionZh: 分组与缺失控件列表，包含标签和附近动作 id。

examples.title: Inspect Vue coverage
examples.code:
const report = pling.inspectCoverage();
console.log(report.coveragePercent, report.targets);
